newsitem.title: TANZANIA: U.N. Rwanda genocide trial postponed.
newsitem.headline: U.N. Rwanda genocide trial postponed.

text.p: The U.N. Rwanda tribunal on Wednesday postponed the trial of a former Rwandan mayor accused of genocide after the defence counsel failed to turn up, tribunal officials said.
Defence lawyers Nicolas Tiangaye of the Central African Republic and Patrice Monthe of Cameroon were delayed because of flight problems and the tribunal will reconvene on Thursday.

Jean-Paul Akayesu, 44, the former mayor of Taba commune in central Rwanda, is charged with genocide and crimes against humanity for his alleged role in the 1994 genocide of an estimated 800,000 Tutsis and Hutu moderates.
He faces life imprisonment, the tribunal's highest penalty, if convicted.
